invariants: Every legacy gap MUST map to at least one canonical Registry ID.
No legacy gap may remain OPEN, ORPHANED, or UNCLASSIFIED.
Authority Registry IDs introduced in this record identify pre-existing authorities only.
A NOT_STANDALONE disposition MUST NOT create a new capability, authority, or root profile.
Primary and secondary targets MUST be registry-addressable IDs.

FA3-AUTH-SECURITY-GOV-001.name: Security/Governance
FA3-AUTH-SECURITY-GOV-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing Security/Governance authority; creates no new authority.

FA3-AUTH-MCP-GATEWAY-001.name: Central MCP/Capability Gateway
FA3-AUTH-MCP-GATEWAY-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing tool/capability mediation authority.

FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001.name: Central Model/Provider Routing Authority
FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing model/provider routing authority.

FA3-AUTH-HOST-RESOURCE-BROKER-001.name: Host Resource Broker
FA3-AUTH-HOST-RESOURCE-BROKER-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing host admission/placement/reservation authority.

FA3-AUTH-OBS-EVIDENCE-001.name: Unified Observability/Evidence
FA3-AUTH-OBS-EVIDENCE-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing telemetry/audit/evidence authority.

FA3-AUTH-SECRETS-001.name: Central Secrets/Secret Broker
FA3-AUTH-SECRETS-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing credential/secret authority.

FA3-AUTH-ORCHESTRATION-001.name: Durable Orchestration / Workflow Execution Authority
FA3-AUTH-ORCHESTRATION-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing durable orchestration/workflow execution authority.

FA3-REG-ARTIFACT-MODEL-001.name: Artifact/Model Registry
FA3-REG-ARTIFACT-MODEL-001.note: Registry identity for the pre-existing Artifact/Model Registry.

mappings.closure: Canonical metadata identity is governed by FA3-REGISTRY-001; authorization/risk identity policy remains Security/Governance.
Artifact/software provenance and attestations are SCS-governed; evidence/audit remains Unified Observability/Evidence.
Artifact identity/lifecycle metadata belongs to Artifact/Model Registry; trust/admission/provenance to SCS.
Model package identity/version metadata is registry-owned; package trust, SBOM, signature and admission are SCS-owned.
Dataset lifecycle, governance projection and dataset-level controls are canonicalized under FA3-DATA-001.
Tool/capability invocation is mediated by Central MCP/Capability Gateway; model/provider invocation routing remains the routing authority.
Discovery/classification is FA3-HW-001; heterogeneous accelerator projection is FA3-HW-MGPU-001; admission/placement/reservation remains Host Resource Broker.
Canonical event envelopes/schema/version semantics are contract-owned; durable event execution belongs to orchestration.
Workflow execution semantics are owned by durable orchestration with canonical workflow/event contracts under FA3-CONTRACT-001.
Policy authorization, exception, risk and enforcement authority remain Security/Governance; no standalone policy authority is created.
Canonical schema identity, compatibility and evolution are part of FA3-CONTRACT-001.
Configuration contracts/versioning are contract-owned; security-sensitive configuration policy remains Security/Governance.
Network/egress enforcement is governed by the canonical firewall/traffic policy fabric decision; Security/Governance remains policy authority.
Disaster recovery, recovery objectives and resilience controls are canonicalized under FA3-RESILIENCE-001.
Human approval/escalation policy is Security/Governance-owned and executed durably by orchestration.
Evaluation, promotion gates and promotion evidence are canonicalized under FA3-EVAL-001.
Capability/tool dispatch is gateway-owned; model/provider dispatch selection remains the model/provider routing authority.
Retrieval-augmented knowledge access is canonicalized under FA3-KNOWLEDGE-001.
Context assembly/optimization and knowledge-context projection are canonicalized under FA3-KNOWLEDGE-001.
Cache is an optimization mechanism, not an authority/capability; semantic/context cache policy is knowledge-layer scoped and physical resource constraints remain Host Resource Broker-owned.
Failure taxonomy/recovery is resilience-owned; machine-stable error envelopes and versioning are contract-owned.
Secret issuance/lease/rotation/revocation belongs to Central Secrets/Secret Broker; access policy remains Security/Governance.
Update artifacts must pass SCS trust/admission/re-evaluation gates; version/identity state is tracked in Artifact/Model Registry.
Extensions/plugins are treated as governed artifacts/providers: trust/admission by SCS, callable capability projection through the MCP/Capability Gateway.
Canonical metadata/state reconciliation is registry-governed with reconciliation evidence emitted through Unified Observability/Evidence.
Data governance is canonicalized under FA3-DATA-001; authorization/risk policy remains Security/Governance.
Data/media rights metadata and governance projection live under FA3-DATA-001; enforcement/exception policy remains Security/Governance.
Media timeline/timebase/finishing semantics are canonicalized under FA3-MEDIA-FINISH-001 with cross-domain temporal semantics from FA3-TEMPORAL-001.
Color management/finishing is canonicalized under FA3-MEDIA-FINISH-001.
Audio mastering/finishing is canonicalized under FA3-MEDIA-FINISH-001.
Caption/subtitle finishing and interchange semantics are canonicalized under FA3-MEDIA-FINISH-001.
Asset identity/version metadata belongs to Artifact/Model Registry; trust/provenance/attestation remains SCS-owned.
Incident lifecycle/recovery is canonicalized under FA3-RESILIENCE-001; telemetry/evidence/audit stays Unified Observability/Evidence-owned.
Compatibility/version negotiation and schema evolution are canonical contract concerns under FA3-CONTRACT-001.
Cross-domain time, deadlines, durations and temporal semantics are canonicalized under FA3-TEMPORAL-001.
Budget/cost/quota envelopes are canonicalized under FA3-BUDGET-001; policy/exception authorization remains Security/Governance.
